alt: A short film with no voice. A lavender bedroom with a clothes rack holding three shirts, coral, yellow and light blue, and a tall oval mirror. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes looks at the rack; the coral shirt flies up and away. A plum figure by the mirror shakes side to side, no. The first figure looks back at the rack; then the plum figure hops with happy eyes, yes. The two look at each other and lean together. The text stays: if someone sent you this, you're going shopping, for an outfit together.
